name: ticketit-contracts
description: Code-generation toolchain for contracts/openapi.yaml. Not a dependency of any application: apps/swiftlet's own build/test/install never installs or runs anything in this package (its generated output is committed to apps/swiftlet/src/api/generated/). This package exists only so a contributor regenerating Swiftlet's types does not have to reconcile this tool's own TypeScript-version requirement against apps/swiftlet's pinned TypeScript version. See README.md, "Why a separate package.json for codegen."
